theorems.statement: ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → E), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, κ * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn F A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun w => Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • F (Φ w)) (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∫ x in A, F x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A, Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • F (Φ w) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))
